pages.text: An insulated box for $(bold)8 food items$(). Food inside never spoils while it's intact.

pages.title: Details
pages.text: It doesn't stack.$(br2)It also stops $(l:advanced/frozen_atmosphere_shard)Atmosphere Shards$(/l) sublimating.$(br2)Stock one before farming fails.
Iron corners, leather sides, a glass bottle for the seal.$(br2)$(flavor)The most important lunchbox in history.$()
